invariants.statement: A state-relevant repository delta must include an OPERATIONAL_STATE.md change in the same change set.
invariants.proof: CI comparison against the exact pre-change Git ref

invariants.statement: A state-relevant repository delta must increase the integer Operational State revision and provide a matching revision-log entry.
invariants.proof: base/current revision comparison plus structural state validation

invariants.statement: Ordinary generated docs and visual-regression baseline changes do not independently force Operational State churn, while docs/asset-manifest.json remains state-relevant provenance evidence.
The freshness checker is read-only and has no repository write, commit, or push path.
The freshness policy, checker, and CI gate cannot be hidden behind their own broad exemptions.
invariants.proof: hard-protected guardrail paths and required policy patterns

invariants.statement: Operational State freshness remains project-state governance only and does not create lore, canon, relationship, chronology, media-identity, publication, or backup authority.
